//: Generates the published type declarations from the JSDoc already in the sources.
Nothing here is compiled: `emitDeclarationOnly` means the .js files ship exactly as written
and only .d.ts files are produced. `checkJs` stays off deliberately — this build exists to
describe the framework to consumers, not to type-check it, and turning it on would make every
loose annotation in 7000 lines of JSDoc a release blocker.
Run with `npm run build:types -w @ti-engine/core`. The output is committed, because the publish
job deliberately runs no install and no lifecycle scripts.
